data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 闭馆后的图书馆
data.description: 【成年 After Story · 雪之下雪乃 · 闭馆后的社区图书馆】二十岁以上成年后的雪乃完成社区读书会工作，独自坐在闭馆书架间的滚轮梯上。修身藏青衬衫被抬起的膝盖勾住并向两侧绷开，一手抓稳梯栏，另一手探入黑色蕾丝裙摆；月光与阅读灯照亮成熟胸线和泛红耳垂。她咬唇压低呼吸——「工作已经结束了……至少在最后一盏灯熄灭前，让我只对自己诚实一次。」
data.action: 独坐书架滚轮梯，一膝抬起勾住衬衫下摆，一手抓梯栏一手探入蕾丝裙摆
data.lighting: dim aisle lights and pale moonlight
data.promptProse: After closing an adult community library, age-twenty-plus Yukino Yukinoshita sits alone on a rolling ladder between moonlit shelves. Her fitted navy blouse is unbuttoned and caught beneath one raised knee, pulling the fabric open across bare breasts. One hand grips the ladder rail while the other disappears under a black lace skirt, keeping the pose grounded without another person. Book spines and a brass reading lamp frame blue eyes, a bitten lip and the first visible crack in her calm expression. Medium vertical solo portrait, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: Perched high on a wooden library rolling ladder after hours with her uniform shirt undone and skirt hitched up, Yukino rests against the bookshelf while sliding her hand beneath her hem in breathless, moonlit secrecy.
